core_obligations: Show that alpha is equidimensional if and only if each g_i^*alpha is (proof lines 1609-1624). Forward: lemma-equidimensional-functoriality (tag 0H5K) (proof lines 1610-1611). Converse: let W be the closure of Supp(alpha) in X; each g_i : S_i -> S is universally open (flat and locally of finite presentation), hence so is f_i : X_i = S_i x_S X -> X; denote alpha_i = g_i^*alpha, then Supp(alpha_i) = f_i^{-1}(Supp(alpha)) by lemma-support-family (tag 0H4V), and since f_i is open, W_i = f_i^{-1}(W) is the closure of Supp(alpha_i) (proof lines 1612-1619); by assumption W_i -> S_i has relative dimension <= r (proof lines 1619-1620); by morphisms-lemma-dimension-fibre-after-base-change (tag 02FY) and the joint surjectivity of the covering, W -> S has relative dimension <= r (proof lines 1621-1623).
proof_roadmap: Forward direction by functoriality of equidimensionality (proof lines 1610-1611).
Openness of the pulled back morphism and the support lemma identify the closure of the pulled back support with f_i^{-1}(W) (proof lines 1612-1619).
Transfer relative dimension <= r from the W_i over S_i to W over S via the fibre-dimension lemma and joint surjectivity (proof lines 1619-1623).
difficulty_reason: 8 行陈述（16 行证明）、相对循环等维性的 fppf 下降：正向一句引理；反向万有开性 → 支撑引理 → f_i^{-1}(W) 即拉回支撑闭包 → 相对维数 ≤ r → 纤维维数引理＋联合满回传。3 处引用全具名，无 omit，干净收。
